name: Theobald's Adventure - Micro RPG
description:
About This Game

Micro RPG

The kingdom is under attack BUT the knights are on vacation! How convenient for the monsters.

It falls to Theobald, an unremarkable peasant with zero combat experience, to save everyone. Trade your hoe for a sword, learn to fight on the fly, and become the legend no one saw coming.

Swirl, Strike, Survive ⚔️

Monsters surround you from every direction. You'll need to time and aim your spinning attacks carefully, hit multiple enemies at once, chain devastating combos, and make split-second decisions. One missed swing or one wrong choice can end your run. The combat is simple to learn, but every fight demands focus and strategy.

Forge Your Legend 🛡️

Before each battle, prepare your loadout. Unlock new weapons, upgrade your heroes, and fine-tune your build to crush whatever comes next. With dozens of weapons to discover and heroes to unlock, no two runs feel exactly the same.

Conquer 12 Worlds 🌍

From quiet farmlands to monster-infested dungeons, each of the 12 worlds brings new enemies, new traps, and new rewards. Complete quests, defeat fearsome (cute) bosses, and uncover the full story of a kingdom that really should have kept at least one knight on duty.

Features

✅ What Micro RPG offers:

  • A unique turn-based combat system: aim your spinning attacks, chain combos, and survive waves of monsters that encircle you.

  • Deep progression: unlock and upgrade heroes and weapons to build your perfect strategy.

  • 10+ hours of content across 12 worlds, quests, bosses, and a full bestiary to complete.

  • Sessions that always end up lasting longer than planned.

❌ What Micro RPG does NOT offer:

  • No live events, multiplayer or competitive leaderboards.

  • No complex story or dialogue. It gets straight to the point.

  • No free exploration; the Worlds follow one another along a predefined path.

About the Devs

Hi! Fred & Dom here, the two-person team behind Micro RPG.

We've been building this game since 2020, listening to our players, and refining every world, weapon, and monster along the way. Bringing Micro RPG to Steam felt like the natural next step: a complete, premium version of everything we've built. No ads, no paywalls, nothing held back.

Theobald has been waiting a long time to meet you. We hope you enjoy his unlikely adventure as much as we enjoyed crafting it. ⚔️

Fred & Dom, JoliYeti
short_desc: Monsters have invaded the kingdom, taking advantage of the knights' annual holiday! You are the last hope! Equip yourself with weapons and fight the monsters surrounding you in this turn-based game with your spinning attacks across a dozen fantasy worlds!
